evals.name: list_test_suites
evals.prompt: List available AXCK test suites for execution
evals.expected_output: Outputs available suites including media, system, service, and HTTP RPC single-case/scenario/stress options.

evals.name: media_stream_verification
evals.prompt: Execute automated media stream on/off and FPS test via serial driver
evals.expected_output: Navigates menu tree to media tests, triggers stream on, validates FPS counter >= 25fps, and exits cleanly.
expectations: Verifies stream on/off state machine transitions
Checks FPS stability and timeout bounds

evals.name: nor_flash_storage_safety
evals.prompt: Run storage and SD card test suite while ensuring NOR Flash space is not consumed
evals.expected_output: Executes DTCF and Storage test commands, directing temporary recordings to /mnt/sdcard or NAS, ensuring /opt and rootfs remain untouched.
expectations: Checks NOR Flash free space threshold
Redirects test artifacts to external SD or RAM tmpfs

evals.name: http_rpc_driver_verification
evals.prompt: Verify HTTP RPC Driver layered architecture and scenario pipeline execution
evals.expected_output: Executes single-case and scenario pipeline via HTTP RPC driver with low-latency JSON validation.
expectations: Validates L0 HTTP client with retry and bypass
Validates L1 domain APIs (media, storage, device, dtcf)
